orders.text:
WPMS No. 2688 of 2015
U.C. Dhyani, J. Mr. Arvind Kumar Sharma, Advocate for 
the petitioner. 
By means of present writ petition, the 
petitioner seeks to issue writ in the nature of 
certiorari quashing the impugned orders dated 
04.05.2012 and 23.05.2012 both passed by 
learned Dy. Director Consolidation / Additional 
District Magistrate, Haridwar. 
Issue notices to the respondents. Steps be 
taken within a week. 
List after the notices are served upon the 
respondents. 
After hearing learned counsel for the 
petitioner, having gone through the documents 
brought on record and after taking cognizance of 
the grounds taken up in the writ petition it is 
provided, as an interim measure, that status quo as 
on today shall be maintained by the parties on the 
land in question till the next date of listing. 
Stay application no. 12442 of 2015 stands 
disposed of. 
 
(U.C. Dhyani, J.)
 29.10.2015 HN
